test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average marks obtained by a group of 25 students was 36. One student left the group, as a result of which the average of the remaining students rose to 37.5. Soon after another student joined the same group, as a result of which the average marks dropped to 37.2. Find the average marks of the student who left and the student who joined the group.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Marks of **student who left** = Old Avg − (Increase in Avg × New Strength) = 36 − (1.5 × 24) = 0

Marks of **student who joined** = New Avg + (Decrease in Avg × Old Strength) = 37.2 + (−0.3 × 24) = 30

Average of these two students = (0 + 30) ÷ 2 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial students = 25, Initial Average = 36. After 1 left, Average = 37.5. After 1 joined, Average = 37.2.

**Formula:** Total Sum = Average × Number of items

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/487320b430d5d2d1840af9a783dc7b6abab05b0b773f6449f419db1d6d1ceaef.png] 

⇒ Total marks of 25 students = 25 × 36 = 900

⇒ Total marks after 1 student leaves (24 students) = 24 × 37.5 = 900

⇒ Marks of the **student who left** = 900 − 900 = 0

⇒ Total marks after 1 more student joins (25 students) = 25 × 37.2 = 930

⇒ Marks of the **student who joined** = 930 − 900 = 30

⇒ Average marks of both students = (0 + 30) ÷ 2 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effect of Adding an Item

Value of new item = New Average + (Change in Average × Previous Number of items).

Effect of Removing an Item

Value of removed item = Previous Average − (Change in Average × New Number of items).

Weighted Average

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is count and x is the average.</p
